outcome: Help authorised teams detect high-risk transactions, returns, accounts and loss patterns while protecting genuine customers and staff.
overview: Shrink and transaction fraud cross channels: a return abused online, a self-checkout under-scan in store, a card tested on a fuel forecourt. Static rules see each in isolation, missing connected abuse while stopping genuine shoppers. This solution scores transactions, returns and accounts against combined POS, e-commerce, payment, device and network signals, then approves, challenges or routes to a case for human review — every intervention carrying a reason code and an audit record. Prohibited features and data minimisation are enforced by design, and staff are never scored outside approved policy. A controlled historical back-test precedes any live pilot, measuring detection lift against a false-positive ceiling.

benefits.text: Reduce confirmed preventable loss from transaction, return and account abuse
benefits.source: Redington Retail catalogue; consistent with published retail fraud and shrink benchmark ranges
benefits.limits: Basis: hypothesis. Effect size to validate on the customer’s own labelled loss history in the back-test — not a guarantee

benefits.text: Improve the false-positive rate so fewer genuine shoppers are challenged or refused
benefits.limits: Basis: hypothesis. Depends on label quality and on the intervention thresholds the customer chooses to operate at

benefits.text: Explain and log 100% of interventions with a reason code, an appeal route and an audit record
benefits.source: Reference design — reason codes, human review and appeal on every intervention path
benefits.limits: A design property verified in case audits; it covers interventions raised through the platform, not manual store action

residency: Deployable in-country on local AWS or Azure regions (e.g. UAE, KSA); transaction, account and case data remain in the customer tenancy in the reference designs

notFor.situation: No labelled outcomes — confirmed fraud, confirmed loss, confirmed genuine
notFor.why: Detection lift and the false-positive ceiling are both measured against labels; without them nothing can be evaluated honestly

notFor.situation: No investigation function to own cases, appeals and outcomes
notFor.why: The design routes risk to humans; a score with no case process becomes an automatic refusal with no recourse

notFor.situation: The intent is staff surveillance or individual employee performance scoring
notFor.why: The reference design prohibits it — employee signals are aggregated and handled under agreed employee-relations policy

scope:
Model: Joint delivery: accredited implementation partner leads, with Redington architecture and commercial governance; the customer owns intervention policy, privacy position, case decisions and every adverse action · Duration: 8–12 weeks PoV; further 16–28 weeks to production scale
Delivery pod: Partner delivery lead + project manager, fraud data scientist, integration engineer; customer loss-prevention owner, fraud operations lead, privacy officer, legal reviewer, payments owner · Support model: Business-hours or 24×7 option; severity-based response targets; partner service desk with vendor escalation
1) Discovery, label review and loss baseline
2) Minimised data integration and privacy sign-off
3) Controlled historical back-test against the incumbent rules
4) Case workflow, reason codes and appeal configuration
5) Controlled live pilot with fairness and drift monitoring
6) Benefit review, case audit and handover
deliverables: Detection lift demonstrated on labelled history against the incumbent rule set
False-positive ceiling respected at the agreed operating threshold
Decision latency within the agreed budget at peak transaction load
Reason codes present on 100% of sampled interventions with the appeal route exercised
Privacy, legal and employee-relations approvals recorded and case UAT completed
effort: 8–12 weeks PoV; further 16–28 weeks to production scale
languages: English delivery; Arabic and English customer-facing challenge and appeal messages supported
